scope.purpose: diagnose v2 collapse, screen one initial v3 table, apply at most one correction, and evaluate the locked v3 table

v2_diagnosis.evidence_boundary: v2 outputs do not contain per-step reward-term decomposition; hydrogen, battery net energy, SOC and FC-step metrics are physical proxies, not reconstructed exact objective contributions
mechanism: A6 uniquely combined the lowest q_h2 and q_batt, the joint-highest q_soc, and the joint-lowest q_fc_var.
The fixed evaluation reward strongly penalizes normalized SOC deviation; A6 therefore gained large SOC-tracking benefit for small changes in hydrogen consumption.
Several other v2 actions varied mainly q_soc and generated nearly identical first control moves around SOC=0.55, so seven nominal actions did not provide seven distinct control tendencies.

notable_redundancy.A1_A2: all 126 probe-state first FC moves were within 1 kW
notable_redundancy.A0_A5: mean absolute first-FC difference was below 1 kW
notable_redundancy.normal_soc_whole_table: mean seven-action first-FC spread was 0.323 kW and every SOC=0.55 probe had spread <=1 kW

initial_v3.decision: rejected: A6 was best on five of six comparable ordinary voyages, all seven remaining hard voyages still failed, and A0/A2/A4 retained near-equivalent first moves

physical_roles.A0: Candidate C fixed baseline and neutral reference action
physical_roles.A1: hydrogen economy: high H2 weight and low battery/SOC weights permit battery discharge to reduce FC energy
physical_roles.A2: balanced: intermediate SOC support with moderate battery and FC-variation costs
physical_roles.A3: SOC maintenance: stronger SOC correction than A2 while retaining FC smoothing
physical_roles.A4: strong SOC regulation: highest SOC weight; it drives both low and high SOC toward 0.55, not charging only
physical_roles.A5: fast FC response: high battery-power cost and very low FC-variation cost make FC follow load changes more actively
physical_roles.A6: FC smoothing: very high FC-variation cost and low battery cost use the battery as the transient buffer

single_correction.small_screen_decision: locked after the single allowed correction: A5 won four and A4 won two of the six comparable ordinary voyages; normal-SOC mean seven-action spread increased to 3.150 kW. No remaining hard voyage was completed by a fixed action, and A2-A3 remained locally redundant.

remaining_local_redundancy: A2-A3 first-FC mean absolute difference 0.096 kW; all 126 probes within 1 kW
A6 incurred 14 maximum-iterations failures under the unchanged formal OSQP settings
assessment.conclusion: v3 is materially less collapsed and physically more interpretable than v2, but it is not yet sufficiently validated as a formal DQN action space: total fixed-action feasibility fell from 350 to 320, all-action-failed voyages increased from seven to eight, and one action pair remains locally redundant. No formal DQN long training should be claimed from this diagnostic.
